whyItMatters: ECB encrypts identical plaintext blocks to identical ciphertext blocks, so data patterns leak through encryption and an observer can infer content structure.
actions: Replace MODE_ECB with an authenticated mode such as GCM at the flagged site.
Generate a unique random nonce per encryption and store it with the ciphertext.
Re-encrypt any data written under ECB and retire the old ciphertext.
verification: The finding disappears on rescan and encryption round-trips with authentication intact.
